_: Seedream 5. Pro bills by output area with one step at 1536x1536; Lite is flat.

bytedance/seedream/v5/pro/text-to-image.description: ByteDance's best stills model. Doubles in price above 1536 by 1536, which the default sits under.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.0675 per image at or below 1536x1536 and $0.135 above it, up to 2048x2048. The size control is a preset rather than a number, so the step is not expressible as a rate here and the entry prices the lower tier; a 2K image is held at half what it costs. Worth revisiting when the sizes become numeric.

bytedance/seedream/v5/pro/edit.description: Seedream Pro working from pictures. Charges a little more for each one after the first.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.0675 per image at or below 1536x1536 and $0.135 above it, plus $0.0045 for each input image after the first.

bytedance/seedream/v5/pro/layerize.description: Splits a picture into layers you can move independently. Nothing to type: it is given the picture and told to take it apart. Billed per layer it produces.

pricing.note: fal publishes $0.03375 per generated layer under 1536x1536 and $0.0675 above. Priced per image because the layer count is not an input; several layers hold as one and settle captures what was produced.

bytedance/seedream/v5/lite/text-to-image.description: Half the price of Pro and flat at every size.

bytedance/seedream/v5/lite/edit.description: Seedream Lite working from a picture.
